```yaml
name: CI Gate

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

  ci:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...

  docs:
    needs: setup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Add .gitbook.yaml
        run: echo "root = \"docs/gitbook\"" > .gitbook.yaml

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install GitBook CLI
        run: npm install -g gitbook-cli

      - name: Build GitBook documentation
        run: gitbook build

  sync-gitbook:
    needs: [ci, docs]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && github.event.release.prerelease == false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Get release version
        id: get_version
        run: echo "::set-output name=version::$(echo ${{ github.ref }} | sed 's/^refs\/tags\///')"

      - name: Sync GitBook branch
        run: |
          git checkout -B docs/v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}
          git add .
          git commit -m "Sync GitBook branch for v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
          git push origin docs/v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}

      - name: Create GitBook variant
        env:
          GITBOOK_API_URL: https://api.gitbook.com
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITBOOK_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"name\": \"V${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }} - Rocky Romp\", \"parent_space_id\": \"$GITBOOK_SPACE_ID\"}" \
            "${{ env.GITBOOK_API_URL }}/spaces/${{ env.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}/variants"
```
